The '''Ice Behemoth Cave''' was a giant cave on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] set up a weapons and supply cache. The cave was inhabited by many [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] as well.
